summary: One bounded offline Qwen3-4B-Base LoRA trial completed from a fresh pinned base. All 224 updates, adapter persistence, fresh reload and post-run input checks passed. This is a quarantined training artifact, not predictive or trading validation.

inputs.instrument: CME 6E futures; research signals for eventual EUR/USD spot/CFD work
inputs.state_key: Each character is the outcome at 1/2/4 extra ticks: N neither-positive, L long-positive, S short-positive. Round-robin order is fixed before fitting.
inputs.source: 2025 train partition only; whole-session first 75% fit and last 25% inner check
inputs.features: 37 causal receive-time snapshot features, including LOB, CVD/OFI and passive/replenishment/absorption proxies
inputs.targets: Delayed-entry 15-second futures quote-opportunity classes, not cTrader execution or PnL
inputs.native_input_isolation: Only the 224 selected prepared training examples plus asset/split metadata; no dataset, historical adapter, CPU model or comparison paths/rows

recipe.initialization: Fresh pinned Qwen3-4B-Base and fresh LoRA; original 20-update adapter not resumed
recipe.dtype: CUDA BF16 with deterministic algorithms and TF32 disabled
recipe.supervision: Completion and real EOS only; prompt and padding masked; no truncation

cpu_gpu_provenance.handling: Preflight initially refused the difference. The new reader verifies the CPU venv's installed NumPy metadata without executing that interpreter, preserves its frozen report and models, and separately verifies the GPU lock/runtime. Integer/hash selection and audits are rebuilt exactly; no CPU control refit or score reinterpretation. No dependency changes.

future_comparison_frozen_before_training.selection: Even rank indices of all 5008 inner-check examples, before this fit; input and target hashes frozen
future_comparison_frozen_before_training.exposure: Already-exposed within-training development; not an independent holdout
future_comparison_frozen_before_training.decoding: Frozen greedy BF16 inference with 48-token limit and strict EOS/JSON/class parsing; no repairs or retries
future_comparison_frozen_before_training.next_step: Implement and test a selected-input-only comparison worker, then run one bounded comparison and score strict coverage and directional outcomes against every frozen control. Do not tune using reserved outcomes.

limitations: 224 unique updates are about 1.5% of the inner-fit examples, not an epoch over the dataset.
Balanced joint-state quotas change the market prior and can increase false directional signals.
Training loss largely rewards output structure as well as class tokens; its reduction does not establish predictive accuracy or profitability.
No inference comparison, independent 2026 evaluation, cTrader fills, PnL or model promotion was performed.
The features are snapshot/proxy inputs, not a trained temporal LOB encoder or confirmed iceberg identification.
Future inference and larger training batches require separate bounded runs; training does not enable autonomous trading or online self-learning.
